scope: The Manitoba Museum and Planetarium in Winnipeg as documented in October 2012, including its gallery blocks, Festival Hall entrance block and copper planetarium dome. The separately registered Centennial Concert Hall is outside the model scope.

references.filename: The Manitoba Museum and Planetarium, Winnipeg, Manitoba.JPG

originalReview.notes: The photograph shows the copper planetarium dome in front of the concrete block, its recessed glass bays and street steps. It includes the immediate museum entrance massing.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact Qualla photo matches the sole Commons original byte for byte. The first file revision carries the CC0 own-work statement and links the historical creator name Ccyyrree. Commons redirects that account to ElatedCoder, which has the same account ID in the original upload and first revision. The separate 2006 photograph is outside the selected date.
